# ServbotShop

> ServbotShop is a dark collector studio selling custom proxy-style cards, token packs, display cards, and land sets for casual play, gifts, and display binders.

ServbotShop products are unofficial custom game pieces. They are not affiliated with or endorsed by Wizards of the Coast and are not tournament legal.

The site supports secure Stripe checkout, customer accounts, order history, contact support, newsletter coupon signup, and admin-managed product, sale, FAQ, blog, and order content.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://servbotshop.com/): ServbotShop storefront overview.
- [Shop](https://servbotshop.com/shop): Current product lineup and category filters.
- [FAQ](https://servbotshop.com/faq): Questions about casual-play legality, custom requests, checkout, and fulfillment.
- [Blog](https://servbotshop.com/blog): Product notes, launch updates, and studio context.
- [Contact](https://servbotshop.com/contact): Customer support and custom inquiry form.
- [Privacy & Cookies](https://servbotshop.com/privacy): Privacy, cookies, analytics, saved checkout information, and marketing email details.

## Product Categories

- [All products](https://servbotshop.com/shop?category=All): Full current lineup.
- [Commander proxies](https://servbotshop.com/shop?category=Commander): Custom commander centerpiece cards for casual play.
- [Token packs](https://servbotshop.com/shop?category=Tokens): Coordinated tabletop token bundles.
- [Display cards](https://servbotshop.com/shop?category=Display): Collector-focused display cards and gifts.
- [Land sets](https://servbotshop.com/shop?category=Land%20Sets): Custom land sets for casual commander tables.

## Current Featured Listings

- [Golden Hour Commander Proxy](https://servbotshop.com/products/golden-hour-commander-proxy): Premium custom commander centerpiece with bold yellow energy and collector-grade presentation.
- [Midnight Token Pack](https://servbotshop.com/products/midnight-token-pack): Coordinated token bundle for casual tables.
- [Velvet Archive Display Card](https://servbotshop.com/products/velvet-archive-display-card): Display-ready custom art card for collectors, gifts, and deck boxes.
- [Social Link Land Set](https://servbotshop.com/products/social-link-land-set): Five-card custom land set with color-coded visual motifs.

## Customer Support Context

- Products are made for casual play, display, and gifts.
- Products are not tournament legal.
- Checkout is handled through Stripe.
- Order updates and fulfillment are managed by ServbotShop.
- Custom questions and order support should use the contact page.

## Optional

- [Account](https://servbotshop.com/account): Customer sign-in, order history, and saved checkout information controls.
